title: October 2019 protest calls and Luanda march surfaced in 2020 searches
reason: Outside assigned year; both the alert references and the opened Radio Angola article identify October 2019.
notes: Sitata describes planned actions on 11, 15 and 19 October and links to 2019 sources; Radio Angola reports a 15 October 2019 march and a separate 19 October call. Not evidence for October 2020.
